jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
OpenAIMP is a leader in artificial intelligence and automated machine learning, focused on delivering both generic and industry-specific models through an open source machine learning platform. Organizations in Finance, Insurance, Healthcare, Retail, Telecommunications, Sales, and Marketing use OpenAIMP’s solutions for mission-critical applications. The platform is designed to simplify and accelerate end-to-end process automation by applying AI in a scalable and efficient way. OpenAIMP also aims to build strategic partnerships with major technology providers, including NVIDIA, IBM, Intel, AWS, Azure, and Google, to enhance its ecosystem and innovation capabilities.
Role Description
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a full-time, on-site role based in Dayton, NJ. The CTO will lead the overall technology vision, roadmap, and execution for OpenAIMP’s AI models and open source platform, ensuring alignment with business strategy and customer needs. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing software and product development teams, guiding architectural decisions, and driving high-quality, secure, and scalable technology solutions. The role involves close collaboration with executive leadership, product management, and key partners to evaluate emerging technologies, optimize platform performance, and support strategic alliances. The CTO will also establish best practices in engineering, mentor technology leaders, manage budgets and resources, and ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations.
Qualifications

Proficiency in Software Development and Architecture for complex, scalable AI or cloud-based platforms.
Experience in Product Development, including defining technical requirements and guiding products from concept to launch.
Strong IT Strategy and Project Management skills to align technology initiatives with organizational goals and deliver on time and within budget.
Demonstrated leadership in building and managing diverse, high-performing engineering and technology teams.
Background in AI, machine learning, data platforms, or related technologies is highly beneficial.
Experience collaborating with enterprise technology partners (e.g., major cloud or hardware providers) is a plus.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making abilities.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Adobe Builders eXperience (ABX)
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

In the last 6 months, agentic development has taken off – changing how software is built. We have a clear vision on how to embrace it, and an engineering org already in motion. We need a product leader to take the spark and own the connection with the builders we serve. They will turn it into strategy and keep evolving that strategy as frameworks, tools, and processes change.

Join us in the ABX org, where agentic development is the platform – a managed harness that 15,000 builders at Adobe will use to ship software with AI. Every improvement you will make compounds across engineering, product, and design, on most codebases at Adobe!

This is a build role. You'll develop the strategy, build the organizational framework from the ground up, and set the bar for what agentic development looks like at Adobe.

What You'll Own

The Builders Experience strategy.
Take an articulated-but-evolving vision and transform it into written strategy, roadmap, and objective measures of success. Expect it to change continuously as the models, harnesses, and internal processes evolve.

The platform spanning all three modes of agentic development.
ABX will serve builders wherever they are on the curve, and make each mode repeatable:

Agentic Delegation - individual acceleration; the SDLC stays the same, each function just gets faster.
Agentic Transformation - cross-functional AI pods that compress the SDLC and dissolve role boundaries.
Agentic Orchestration - ticket-to-PR factories, multi-agent loops, self-healing CI, with customer and SRE signal closing the outer loop.

The objectives and key results (OKRs).
Platform adoption → per-engineer output → per-employee productivity → business impact. We start with adoption and build up to the rest.

The relationship with the builders.
Deepen trust with the Adobe Builders community, as past decisions on models and tooling created friction. You'll build the engagement mechanisms for a real partnership, and act as chief marketer and evangelist for the platform across the org!

Build vs. buy.
Own the decision process for which external models and tools we deploy. Know the latest across the labs, hyperscalers, and open-weights - and make high-conviction calls amid an embarrassment of riches.

Execution.
Relentless focus on shipping. Remove bottlenecks, streamline how the team communicates, and automate our own SDLC intelligently - designing the moments where humans stay in the loop so judgment and taste get applied at the junctures that matter.

The operating model.
Design how this team runs, in partnership with engineering. It must be agentic itself - we build the system with our system and eat our own dog food. Expect AI pods with real ownership, some led by non-PMs and product-design-engineer (PDE) profiles, not the classic backlog-and-execute approach.

A small PM team.
Direct one PM today (who owns external-tool deployment decisions) and grow the org as the mandate expands - setting the hiring bar and the culture as you go.

What You'll Bring

Senior PM leadership with a track record of building strategy and teams from scratch
Technical credibility with builders. The best instinct here is an engineer's instinct for what engineers want - we're building tools for people who like to build their own tools. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read it and reason about it.
Deep technical fluency in agentic systems: model evaluation and selection, orchestration frameworks, evaluations, inference cost, MCP and the surrounding dev-tooling stack. Comfortable debating latency-vs-accuracy tradeoffs with principal engineers.
Strategic clarity under ambiguity. The landscape shifts weekly; you will synthesize signal from noise, make high-conviction bets on incomplete information, and adjust course as needed.
Comfort operating lean and unconventionally - small team, novel AI pods structure, strong bias to action, allergic to process theater and fluff.
A driver of reinvention - energized by collapsing role boundaries and remaking the SDLC to be AI-first.

What Sets You Apart

You've led product for a developer or AI platform inside a large engineering org (hundreds to thousands of engineers), and driven adoption of AI-augmented development tooling at scale.
You're boundary-less - you'll collaborate across Adobe and go where the outcome takes you.
You can converse across the whole agentic stack: agentic coding, CI/CD, build systems, observability, evaluations, orchestration.
A technical degree (CS, Math, Engineering, or related) or equivalent experience. We value what you've built over where you studied.

Be ready for

A vision that will change, repeatedly. We optimize for agility over certainty.
A team that's small by design, with a non-standard operating model you'll co-invent.
Being both architect and customer of what we build. That reinforcement loop - the system building itself, and getting smarter every time Adobe builds on it - is our MO.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is seeking a Sr. Product Manager - Technical to directly influence the direction of AWS products through the customer experience lens. We seek a technically proficient person to join our team working with AWS leadership to deliver innovative products to customers worldwide. We are the independent internal product consultants advising senior leaders on AWS product opportunities and direction.

This role needs a person who is passionate to understand about the best customer experiences across providers including AWS. They stay on top of technical innovation and advances WW, with an eye on identifying opportunities where AWS can positively impact CX the most. This role requires dive deep into current and future customer needs and deliver actionable insights that drive development of continuously improving AWS products, customer workflows, and features. Primary deliverables are reports with narratives that cover both the CX and performance aspects of customer use cases for AWS which are presented to senior AWS leadership to influence them in products like AI Services, GenAI/ Agentic AI customer applications, AI Hardware etc. to deliver the best customer experience. This role allows a person to explore different parts of AWS with a strategic vantage point.

The person will excel at influencing stakeholders without formal authority, across a wide range of technical profiles and seniority levels. They write well, and their verbal communication is concise and perceptive. As a Product Manager-Tech, they tirelessly advocate on behalf of customers and escalate immediately when they believe course correction is needed. Finally, they deliver results without compromising on quality.

Key job responsibilities

Design and build proof of concept experiments that best describe the quality (performance and ease of use) of the customer experiences of AWS products and services
Collaborate with engineering and science teams to build products and processes for efficient performance evaluations of AWS services
Develop roadmap for evaluations by synthesizing AWS product plans, customer needs, and industry trends
Own entire evaluation lifecycle from scoping, to execution, to delivery of findings and recommendations on CX of AWS products to AWS leadership through crisp narratives
Continuously absorb and share knowledge about the latest product and scientific developments relevant to AWS/cloud space with a focus on AI services, and AI Hardware.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback to prioritize the day's decisions. Mid-morning, you join an architecture review with your engineering team, probing design choices and surfacing trade-offs. After lunch, you draft a product brief for an upcoming feature, then sync with design partners on prototypes. Later, you present your roadmap updates to senior leaders and gather input from cross-functional stakeholders. Throughout it all, you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving, staying close to both the customer experience and the technical details.

About The Team

Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings. We focus on performance, customer/developer experience, and agentic experience of using AWS products and services .

Bachelor's degree
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
2+ years of cloud architecture and designing and implementing cloud solutions experience

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Engineering – Modular Infrastructure – OCI Data Center Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Job Description

This leader will drive the transformation of OCI's infrastructure delivery model by shifting

engineering and construction activities from the field into manufacturing environments through

modularization, off-site assembly, skidding, and integrated product development. The

organization will partner closely with Design Engineering, Architecture, Supply Chain,

Manufacturing, Construction, and strategic OEMs to develop scalable infrastructure products

that improve deployment velocity, reduce field labor, enhance quality, and increase consistency

across OCI's global fleet.

The Product Engineering organization will own the product strategy and lifecycle for

standardized infrastructure modules, including integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and

controls assemblies. This includes defining product requirements, influencing supplier

technology roadmaps, managing OEM partnerships, developing product qualification strategies,

and driving Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles

throughout the engineering lifecycle.

A key responsibility of this organization will be identifying opportunities to convert traditional

stick-built infrastructure into repeatable, modular products that can be manufactured, tested,

transported, and deployed at scale. Areas of focus include integrated cooling systems, power

distribution assemblies, skidded mechanical plants, prefabricated electrical rooms, combined

CDU/fan systems, Heat Absorption Chillers (HAC), piping assemblies, controls packages, and

other standardized infrastructure solutions that improve scalability and deployment efficiency.

Working across the entire infrastructure lifecycle, this leader will ensure modular products align

with OCI's design standards, manufacturing capabilities, construction methodologies, operational

requirements, and long-term technology roadmap. The organization will also partner with OEMs

to influence future product development, ensuring suppliers build products optimized for OCI's

unique scale, performance, and deployment needs.

The ideal candidate combines deep experience in product engineering, modular construction,

manufacturing, critical infrastructure systems, and supplier development with a demonstrated

ability to build engineering organizations and commercialize innovative infrastructure

technologies at hyperscale.

Responsibilities

Build and Lead the Function

Establish and scale OCI's Product Engineering organization focused on modular infrastructure and industrialized construction.- Develop the organization's strategy, operating model, product lifecycle processes, and execution roadmap.
Build multidisciplinary engineering teams spanning product engineering, systems

engineering, manufacturing engineering, supplier engineering, technical program

management, and product lifecycle management.

Establish engineering processes supporting concept development, product qualification,

manufacturing readiness, deployment, sustaining engineering, and product evolution.

Modular Infrastructure Strategy

Define and execute OCI's long-term modularization strategy across mechanical,

electrical, plumbing, structural, and controls infrastructure.

Identify opportunities to transition field-built infrastructure into standardized modular

products.

Develop reusable product platforms that enable consistent deployment across OCI's

global data center portfolio.

Establish product architectures that improve scalability, reduce deployment timelines,

and simplify installation and commissioning.

Continuously evaluate emerging modular technologies and manufacturing capabilities to

improve deployment efficiency.

Product Engineering & Lifecycle Management

Own the engineering lifecycle for OCI's modular infrastructure product portfolio.
Define product requirements, technical specifications, validation plans, qualification

criteria, lifecycle management strategies, and product roadmaps.

Lead cross-functional product development from concept through production deployment and sustaining engineering.
Ensure products meet OCI requirements for performance, reliability, manufacturability,

serviceability, and lifecycle cost.

Partner with Design Engineering to integrate standardized products into future data center

design platforms.

OEM Partnerships & Supplier Development

Develop strategic engineering partnerships with OEMs, contract manufacturers, and

technology suppliers.

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Product Management - DV Publisher Suite
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Founded in 2008, DoubleVerify (DV) is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance by bringing transparency and accountability to the market and ensuring ad viewability, brand safety, fraud protection, accurate impression delivery and audience quality across campaigns to drive performance. DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies across every major vertical, including financial services, telecom, automotive, retail, CPG, travel, luxury and pharmaceuticals gain the most value out of their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital ecosystem. Let's build a better industry.

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Product Management — DV Publisher Suite owns the product strategy, roadmap and delivery for DoubleVerify Publisher Suite, a comprehensive suite of revenue analytics, quality & performance measurement, and inventory curation tools. DV Publisher Suite customers include some of the most recognized names in media spanning Broadcasters, News, Retailers and Device Manufacturers

The portfolio is broad and technically deep. It spans revenue analytics — a suite of tools for all publisher monetisation needs, managing both direct and programmatic datasets, letting clients build reports, dashboards, and forecasts across their entire revenue base– and the Inventory Quality & Targeting Suite is DVPS's analytics and curation suite that lets publishers discover and prove out their high-performing, authentic inventory. It measures across the same quality and performance pillars advertisers value.

Publishers are a fundamentally different customer than advertisers: different economics, different buying centers, different definitions of success. This role exists to make sure DV builds for them on their terms. You will lead a team of five Product Managers, partner closely with a dedicated publisher engineering organization and a dedicated publisher sales and client support team, and operate as the product leader of a focused, entrepreneurial unit with a single goal — profitable growth in the publisher business.

The mandate is ambitious. You will set a multi-year product vision for how premium publishers monetize in an environment reshaped by streaming, curation, AI-driven content discovery and continued pressure on open-web economics. You will make hard portfolio calls about where to invest, where to simplify and where to stop. And you will be accountable for delivery: clear requirements, realistic scope, and products that ship and get adopted.

This is a role for a product leader who can innovate against a long-term vision and a quarterly commercial reality at the same time — who is energized by owning a business, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and credible with publishers, engineers and executives alike.

Job Responsibilities

Own and be accountable for the DVPS product vision, strategy, roadmap and revenue outcomes across the full portfolio — Revenue Analytics and Inventory Quality & Targeting product suites
Lead, coach and grow a team of five Product Managers; raise the bar on product craft, customer discovery and delivery discipline, and develop the next generation of product leaders on the team.
Partner with the GM of the Publisher business as the product leader, jointly setting priorities against revenue and customer commitments while owning product strategy and prioritization.
Drive delivery velocity in close partnership with the dedicated Publisher engineering organization; establish clear requirements, make explicit prioritization decisions, and manage scope.
Define and analyze the metrics that determine whether DVPS products are winning — adoption, revenue attach, retention, and publisher-side yield impact — and use them to reallocate investment.
Own competitive and market position for publisher-side analytics, delivery and quality; ensure DV remains the best publisher product in market.
Engage directly and frequently with premium publishers and industry bodies, including IAB working groups; represent DV at industry events, standards groups and customer executive reviews.
Coordinate with DV's broader product organization on shared platform capabilities — classification, fraud, measurement infrastructure and reporting — to ensure DVPS benefits from company-wide investment rather than rebuilding it.
Become the organization's go-to authority on publisher monetization, sell-side verification, and the DV Publisher Suite.

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of total professional experience, including 7+ years in Product Management.
3+ years of people management experience with Product Managers as direct reports, including hiring, performance management and career development.
3+ years of product experience in publisher-side advertising technology — publisher ad servers, order and inventory management systems, header bidding, SSPs, yield management, revenue analytics or programmatic monetization.
Demonstrated ownership of a product line with direct revenue accountability, including the tradeoffs between long-term platform investment and near-term commercial commitments.
Track record of leading products from strategy through launch and adoption, including complex platform migrations and modernization of mature products.
Superior data analysis skills; able to personally derive insight and action from data rather than delegating it.
Experience partnering effectively with a distributed engineering organization, including across time zones and cultures.
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to present credibly to executives, to engineers, and to publisher customers.
Organized with rigorous attention to detail and a demonstrated bias toward decisiveness under ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience at a premium publisher, SSP, ad exchange or publisher-side monetization platform.
Deep working knowledge of media quality measurement — invalid traffic and fraud, brand safety and suitability, viewability, attention — applied to sell-side use cases.
Familiarity with CTV and streaming supply, and with how premium publishers package and sell it.
Experience building/developing a high-caliber product team.
Experience with agile development at scale, and with UX partnership on research, prototyping and usability.
Hands-on SQL and data analysis capability.
B.S. or higher in Computer Science, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV.

The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $219,000 - $336,000. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
About Scale AI

Scale AI accelerates the development and deployment of AI, from the high-quality training data and evaluation services that power the world's leading AI labs, to full-stack AI applications built for Enterprise, U.S. Public Sector, and Global Public Sector customers. We don't just hand over a model; we find the highest-value use case, build the system around it, and own the outcome, whether that's an agent supporting mission planning for the Department of Defense, a sovereign AI platform for a government ministry, or an agentic workflow inside a Fortune 500 enterprise. Our platform powers breakthroughs at the frontier of AI, and great design is how we make that power accessible, intuitive, and trusted by the teams who rely on it every day.

The Role

We're looking for a product design leader to lead and grow our enterprise team.

What You'll Do

Set the direction for Enterprise design. Define what exceptional design looks like for Scale's Applications customers making high-stakes decisions and for the expert contributors powering the platform. Translate the broader design vision into a clear, motivating direction for your team.
Build and lead the team. Own hiring, development, and day-to-day leadership for a growing team of designers. Create the culture and operating rhythms that let them do their best work.
Drive design execution across the Enterprise product. Partner with your Product and Engineering counterparts to set priorities and ensure design is involved from problem scoping through delivery, not brought in at the end.
Raise the craft bar. Uphold design principles and quality standards on your team. Push designers beyond digitizing workflows toward genuinely rethinking how people work with AI. Hold the line on quality without slowing delivery.
Contribute to the design system. Help shape and adopt Scale's shared design system, championing consistent component use and contributing patterns back so a distributed team can build coherently at speed.
Ground the team in user needs. Build the research habits and cadences that keep your team's decisions rooted in what enterprise customers and users actually need, and advocate for that discipline with your Product and Engineering partners.
Shape Scale's approach to human-agent interaction. Scale's core value is human-in-the-loop AI, and the interface is where trust is built or lost. Help define the interaction patterns for how enterprise users work alongside AI agents, and contribute to Scale's growing point of view on this emerging space.

Who You Are

3+ years managing product design teams
Proven track record of simplifying data-dense, power-user workflows into elegant solutions for B2B and beyond
Deeply customer-centric, with a track record of grounding design decisions in real user needs and business impact
Fluent in how AI is changing design practice and tooling; building AI-native workflows for your team
Experience designing for agentic platforms, and excited to shape the future of interaction patterns for AI and human-in-the-loop systems
Balance speed and quality; you know how to prioritize ruthlessly and get the team shipping without dropping the craft bar
Excellent communicator. You can present to a leaders and a front-line PM and make both feel heard

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Remote, US

About Nametag

Nametag is building the future of secure digital identity. Our mission is to protect every human identity to restore trust in the AI era. We bring workforce-grade identity verification into the enterprise to verify the human behind accounts and critical actions. Today, global enterprises use Nametag across their workforce to prevent social engineering and deepfake impersonation attacks.

The Role

Nametag is hiring a Director of Product Marketing to own positioning, launch, and sales enablement for Nametag's core identity verification platform and its solutions; the account-recovery and helpdesk workflows most of today's revenue and pipeline run through. This is a senior, individual-contributor role for someone who has carried product marketing end to end at a B2B security company before: positioning that holds up under a CISO's scrutiny, launches that ship with sales enablement attached instead of following weeks later, and competitive claims a competitor's own product marketer would call fair. You'll be the person other teams turn to for the accurate, current answer on how Nametag describes itself across sales conversations, the website, analyst briefings, and every deck in between.

Role Overview

As Director of Product Marketing, you will own positioning and messaging for Nametag's core identity verification platform, and be the point of accountability for keeping that message consistent as the company grows quickly. You will lead messaging and materials creation for new product launches, build and maintain the sales enablement and competitive materials our go-to-market teams rely on daily, keep strict documentation of all product features and new releases, and partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Growth Marketing, Channel Partnerships, and Product Management. You’ll also have particularly close ties to the ITSM and IAM integration ecosystem (Okta, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Zendesk).

What you’ll do

Positioning & Messaging

Own Nametag's core-IDV narratives, and serve as the arbiter of how they're positioned across every customer-facing surface.
Maintain and enforce the company's messaging and style guide: sourcing rules, canonical terminology, approved claims, so the same product doesn't end up with different language in the market at once.
Translate product capabilities into messaging that holds up for a CISO, a security/IAM leader, an IT leader, and a helpdesk leader; the buyers and influencers Nametag sells into.

Product Launches & Go-to-Market

Own the go-to-market plan for new core-platform and solution modules and features from kickoff to launch: messaging, positioning, sales enablement, and cross-functional coordination with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.
Build repeatable launch frameworks: messaging pillars, soundbites, ICP and stakeholder mapping, objection handling, so each launch doesn't start from a blank page.
Define and track launch success metrics in partnership with Product Management and Marketing Ops.

Competitive Intelligence & Differentiation

Own competitive battlecards and differentiation materials against MFA/authentication vendors and consumer-grade KYC vendors expanding into workforce use cases, and keep them current as the market moves.
Research and articulate how Nametag's core verification differs from adjacent categories in terms a technical buyer will find credible, not dismissive.
Keep every competitive claim sourced and fair: testable against how the competitor would describe themselves.

Sales Enablement

Build and maintain the materials Sales, Customer Success, and Channel Partnerships use daily for deals: one-pagers, talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handling, and the master decks used with prospects.
Train Sales and Solutions Engineering on new positioning, features, and competitive intelligence.
Partner with Channel Partnerships on enablement for technology and reseller partners (e.g., ServiceNow, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID), so partner-sourced deals have the same quality of material as direct ones.

Analyst & Industry Relations

Brief industry analysts (e.g., Gartner, KuppingerCole) and manage Nametag's participation in relevant IAM/identity-verification research and reports, including our current Gartner Magic Quadrant Visionary recognition.
Represent Nametag's product story at industry events, webinars, and customer-facing presentations.

Pricing, Packaging & Proof

Own how Nametag communicates pricing and packaging for the core platform and solutions.
Maintain the ROI/TCO methodology used in sales conversations (e.g., helpdesk ticket reduction, cost-per-reset), with sourcing rigorous enough to survive a technical buyer's second look.
Develop customer stories and case studies with named accounts, in partnership with Customer Success, that hold up as proof rather than testimonials.

Customer & Market Research

Maintain and refine Nametag's IT/security ICP and buyer-persona models as the customer base grows into new verticals.
Stay current on the threat landscape and regulatory environment Nametag's customers operate in, and translate that into content and talking points Sales and Marketing can use.

What You Bring

We encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every listed qualification. You'll thrive in this role if you bring most of the following:

8+ years
in product marketing, including several years at a B2B cybersecurity, identity, or enterprise security software company.
A track record of owning positioning and messaging for a technical security product, and making it hold up under scrutiny from CISOs and security/IAM leaders.
Experience leading product launches end to end: messaging, sales enablement, and cross-functional coordination, not just the content around the edges of one.
Deep fluency with enterprise security buyers and B2B security sales cycles; comfortable being precise about technical distinctions (e.g., authentication vs. verification) that matter to a technical audience.
Familiarity with the ITSM/IAM integration ecosystem (Okta, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Zendesk) is a strong plus.
Strong competitive intelligence instincts: comfortable building battlecards and differentiation frameworks that are accurate and fair, not just favorable.
Experience partnering with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, KuppingerCole, or similar) is a strong plus.
Excellent, disciplined writing. Comfortable being the person who enforces consistent terminology and voice across a fast-moving team, not just the person who writes copy.
Experience with sales enablement tooling (e.g., HubSpot) and building or maintaining ROI/TCO models is a plus.
A strong sense of ownership: comfortable being the final word on message consistency at a small, fast-growing company where that job doesn't yet have a lot of scaffolding around it.
Enthusiasm for integrating AI tools like Claude into your everyday workflow; a keen sense of the difference between “AI slop” and AI-generated assets.

What We Value

Intellectual horsepower.
Quickly grasping complex technical and business concepts.
Kindness and integrity.
Earning trust is central to how we build relationships with customers and colleagues.
Bias for action.
We move quickly to deliver impact and protect our customers against fast-moving threats.
Ownership mindset.
You care about uptime and stability the way a founder cares about the product.

Culture & Perks

At Nametag, we believe trust starts with how we treat each other. We're a remote-first team that values autonomy, inclusivity, and collaboration, with regular in-person time to stay connected and innovate together.

Remote-first:
Work from anywhere in the US. Our team spans Seattle, San Francisco, Ann Arbor, Denver, New York City, and beyond.
Off-sites:
We bring the team together once per quarter for in-person collaboration, often off-site in new places.
Flexible schedules:
Work in your own time zone; we align key meetings across a shared window.

We Offer

Competitive salary
Meaningful equity ownership
Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)
Flexible paid time off
Quarterly team off-sites and travel support
New computer hardware and equipment
An inclusive environment where your voice has impact and your work drives change

0-1 instincts paired with execution rigor.

jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft's transition to quantum-safe cryptography is a company-wide, multi-year change spanning encryption in transit, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and encryption at rest. Success requires more than publishing standards or building foundational components. Microsoft needs a reliable way to measure adoption, expose gaps, assign accountability, and drive decisions across organizations that own their own roadmaps. Key Management is a critical product area in the transition. Quantum-safe outcomes depend on the readiness of key-management services, key hierarchies, Hardware Security Modules (HSM) hardware and firmware, and related compliance dependencies.

As a Principal Product Manager
for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Adoption & Key Management, you will define what readiness means, what Microsoft measures, and how leaders act on the evidence. You will work closely with the Key Management team on its PQC product strategy and roadmap, while using that product work as a proving ground for the broader adoption model. Your job is to make the transition concrete: clear requirements, measurable progress, explicit owners, sequenced dependencies, and credible commitments to leadership, customers, and regulators.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Responsibilities

Define PQC readiness and measurement. Own outcome targets, KPIs, scorecards, telemetry requirements, and adoption bars across encryption in transit, PKI, and encryption at rest.
Drive accountable cross-team results. Use existing governance and reviews to turn gaps or missed targets into named blockers, owners, decisions, and checkpoints.
Lead customer, field, compliance, and CELA engagement. Present Microsoft's PQC direction and translate customer, audit, regulatory, and government requirements into product priorities and timelines.
Own the product roadmap and adoption narrative. Publish clear PQC roadmaps and guidance that distinguish committed capabilities from plans, dependencies, exceptions, and open decisions.
Support Key Management PQC readiness. Partner on strategy, roadmap decisions, and customer discussions across Azure Key Vault, Managed HSM, external key management, key-protection libraries, and HSM platforms.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Significant product-management experience in security, cloud infrastructure, cryptography, key management, identity, or compliance.
Proven ability to define KPIs and drive measurable results across teams you do not directly manage.
Customer-facing experience presenting technical roadmaps and translating customer, regulatory, and government requirements into product decisions.
Strong product judgment translating standards, compliance obligations, and technical dependencies into priorities, sequencing, and tradeoffs.
Clear executive communication and demonstrated influence across engineering, field, compliance, legal, policy, and governance teams.
Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, including ML-KEM, ML-DSA, hybrid transition patterns, or CNSA 2.0; cloud key management and HSMs; large-scale cryptographic migrations; and security governance or compliance programs.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager-Tech, Event Automation & Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description

Want to build and define how Amazon utilizes AI to run Amazon's biggest shopping events? We're hiring a Senior Product Manager - Technical to own EMERGE — the AI-native platform that orchestrates Prime Day, Black Friday, and 30+ high-velocity events across 22 marketplaces — with complete authority over the product's roadmap and future.

This is one of the most hands-on AI product roles at Amazon. EMERGE is transforming from an orchestration platform into a multi-agent AI system where specialized agents create events, generate content, manage levers, and coordinate 40+ partner teams — work that once took weeks now happens in minutes. You will define what AI-native event execution looks like for the entire company, and you'll do it with rare autonomy: you own the UX, the technical architecture direction, and the business strategy end-to-end.

Design and ship multi-agent AI systems on the bleeding edge of AI integration at Amazon — agentic workflows, multi-agent coordination, and intelligent automation in production at global scale
Total product ownership: you are the single decision-maker for roadmap, user experience, technical direction, and business outcomes — no committees.
Your work appears on Amazon's highest-traffic pages during the company's highest-revenue events
Influence how 10+ organizations across Tech, Stores, Marketing, and Merchandising adopt AI automation

Key job responsibilities

Own EMERGE (Event Orchestration) completely — vision, roadmap, UX, technical direction, and business strategy. You are the single-threaded leader with final authority over what the product becomes

Define and execute the platform's AI-native transformation: design the multi-agent architecture (event orchestration, event creation, lever management, content/wireframe generation, and strategy agents) that automates event execution company-wide
Push the frontier of applied AI at Amazon — evaluate emerging agentic patterns, run pilots, and scale what works into production systems serving hundreds of millions of customers
Design the human-AI interaction model: decide where agents act autonomously, where humans steer, and where manual control remains — and build the UX that makes that seamless
Own a portfolio of 25+ partner integrations, building data-driven business cases that influence partner team roadmaps across 8+ organizations
Establish the governance mechanisms — SLA frameworks, automated validation, guardrails — that let AI agents move fast on customer-facing surfaces without compromising safety
Author strategic documents (PR/FAQs, OP1 inputs, 3-year plans) and present your AI strategy to senior leadership up to VP level
Drive operational excellence and event readiness for Prime Day and other tentpole events

A day in the life

You own this product outright — so your day is what you decide it should be. That might mean a morning design session on your next AI agent: how should the event-creation agent handle ambiguity, when should it ask a human, and what does the review UX look like? Midday, you're running an evaluation of a new agentic pattern against your production baseline, deciding whether it's ready for the front page of Amazon. Afternoon, you're pitching a partner org on replacing their manual workflow with your agent-driven integration — armed with pilot data proving the efficiency gain.

Your internal customers are the event managers, marketing, and merchandising teams who execute Amazon's events worldwide; your product's job is to give them AI teammates that eliminate their manual work. Your stakeholders span capacity planning, content, homepage, advertising, and deal-sourcing teams across 8+ organizations. The problems are the interesting kind: How autonomous can an agent be when a mistake shows up on Amazon's homepage during Prime Day? How do you design trust and control into agentic UX? How do you make one AI-native platform the source of truth an entire company builds on?

During event season, you're watching your agents execute live at global scale. Between events, you're setting the direction — because the roadmap is yours, from the next quarter's launches to the three-year vision.

About The Team

The WW Events Tech team owns the technology behind Amazon's high-velocity events — the systems that plan, orchestrate, and execute Prime Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday, and dozens of recurring events across 22 marketplaces. We are betting the future of this space on AI: our mission is to make Amazon event execution AI-native, where agents do the work of coordination, creation, and validation that once consumed weeks of effort from 40+ teams.

We're a builder culture operating at the front edge of Amazon's AI adoption, with direct senior leadership visibility and an appetite for bold bets. Product managers here have real authority — you work daily with engineers and Principal Engineers, own your space end-to-end, and see your decisions reflected on Amazon's highest-traffic pages within weeks, not quarters. We value bias for action, data-driven influence, and backbone. The platform foundation is built and adopted by 40+ teams; the AI-native chapter is just beginning, and this role is the author of it.

Bachelor's degree
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

jobs.description:
Description

The Principal, Product Manager in Talent Management is a senior individual contributor who designs, leads, and scales enterprise-wide talent management strategies and programs. This role operates with significant autonomy in highly ambiguous environments, driving talent management initiatives across multiple business units or geographies. The Principal serves as a recognized subject-matter expert and trusted advisor to senior leaders (Director and VP level), shaping the talent agenda and influencing long-term workforce strategy.

Come Build How Amazon Grows Its Best People

Amazon doesn't just hire great talent — we obsess over how to develop, retain, and grow it. Our Talent Management team builds the programs, systems, and strategies that shape the employee experience for over 1.5 million people worldwide. This is where people science meets product thinking at a scale no other company can match.

We're looking for a Principal who thinks like a product leader and operates like a program owner. Someone who can take a complex, cross-functional challenge — spanning product, UX, engineering, and analytics — and turn it into a launched experience with clear strategy, measurable outcomes, and executive-level visibility. You'll own end-to-end product management and design for talent programs, writing docs, orchestrating cross-functional teams, and presenting to PXT leadership monthly. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write one.

Key job responsibilities

Enterprise Talent Strategy: Design and own the end-to-end talent management strategy for the enterprise, including talent evaluation, high-potential identification and retention, performance management, and AI-enhanced talent experiences.
Product Ownership & Delivery: Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for talent management programs. Write strategy docs, engage UX/Design/Analytics/Engineering partners, and drive cross-functional teams to ship at scale — without direct authority over those teams.
Executive Communication: Present product launches and program updates to PXT LT and executives monthly. Translate complex technical and programmatic work into crisp narratives for senior leadership.
Organizational Health & Insights: Leverage data and analytics to diagnose organizational health trends, identify talent risks, and develop proactive interventions. Translate complex talent data into actionable insights for senior leadership.
Talent Evaluation & Calibration: Design talent evaluation and calibration processes, ensuring consistency, fairness, and alignment with role guidelines and leadership principles.
Growth & Development: Architect and implement scalable growth & development programs that accelerate the growth of high-value talent and address capability gaps across the organization.
AI Transformation: Drive experimentation and adoption of AI-powered talent experiences, partnering closely with engineering and technical teams to bring innovation from concept to production.
Mechanisms & Scalability: Create scalable mechanisms, tools, and frameworks that raise the bar on talent management practices and can be adopted broadly across the company.

A day in the life

You'll own the full lifecycle of products and programs that have considerable impact across multiple Amazon organizations. That means defining the mission and vision, writing strategy documents, aligning with senior leaders, building go-to-market and change management plans, and driving execution across UX, Design, Analytics, and Program Management teams that don't report to you.

You'll develop KPI frameworks that give leadership real visibility into performance, and you'll use data to tell the story of what's working and where to push harder.

You'll be the connective tissue between product, design, technical, and business teams — identifying gaps before they become failures, sourcing and coordinating resources across organizations, and proactively mitigating risks that others haven't spotted yet. When a problem is ambiguous, you'll define it. When a path forward isn't clear, you'll build one.

About The Team

The Compensation & Talent team is a newly formed organization within PXT that brings together talent evaluation, performance management, and compensation under one leader. Our mission is to accelerate and advance how Amazon identifies and rewards its people — uniting the full cycle of talent assessment and compensation into a streamlined, end-to-end experience. We own compensation product, tech, and program management, as well as talent management design, program, and policy work.

You'll operate at the intersection of people strategy and technology, working on initiatives that directly influence how Amazon identifies, develops, and retains talent at unprecedented scale. jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical with a strong technical background to own our vision for the operator console that Amazon's next-generation fulfillment buildings are run on. This is a deeply technical role. You will work side by side with software development managers, science managers, and engineers, and you will push them to build better, faster, and cheaper with more capability every quarter. We are not looking for someone to ship another monitoring dashboard. We want someone who drives the team past monitoring and alarms toward a building that catches and resolves its own problems before a human ever sees them.

That ambition is concrete: move each capability up an arc from a health overview, to automated root-cause on an issue, to a recommended next best action, to directed and eventually autonomous resolution. You will own how far and how fast our equipment advances along that arc, and you will hold engineering and science to the bar that gets us there. This is also a role for someone who leads through influence. The console is built jointly across several Amazon organizations, so you will be the single product voice for how our equipment works in it, aligning partner teams you do not control and turning several groups' priorities into one coherent product. The strategy is still being written, so you will create clarity where the problem is not yet fully defined.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product strategy, vision, and multi-quarter roadmap for how our equipment shows up in the console, and push it up the arc from monitoring toward autonomous resolution.
Engage engineering and science leaders as a technical peer: challenge complexity estimates, weigh architecture trade-offs on their merits, and define acceptance criteria for software that runs a live building for years.
Be the single product voice for our organization across the partner teams that co-build the console, earning alignment through shared interest rather than escalation and reconciling competing priorities into one experience.
Own the business value case for your product, cost to run versus operational value delivered, and make build, extend, or partner calls with clear justification.
Run customer research in live fulfillment buildings, manage deployment readiness with Operations, sequence inbound demand against committed launches, and own the post-launch health of what you ship against adoption, reliability, cost avoided, and customer satisfaction.

A day in the life

What your morning will look like if we are successful: You start with overnight telemetry across deployed sites and a class of alarm the system should have caught and cleared on its own, which becomes your next roadmap push. Mid-morning you are with your engineering lead pressure-testing whether an automated root-cause capability can hit the latency it needs at the data volume a live building throws at it, and you hold the line on the harder, better answer. After lunch you align partner-team product leaders on how their data and your equipment views coexist in one screen, then run office hours with floor technicians during a surge to see where the product still makes them think too hard. You end the day walking a deployment readiness checklist with Operations for a building commissioning next quarter. Your customers are the operators, engineers, and technicians who use your product every day in fulfillment buildings.

About The Team

We are a division within Amazon Fulfillment Technology and Robotics focused on standardizing the equipment and systems that make up our first, middle, and last mile facilities. We are a passionate group of innovators, engineers, and business leaders dedicated to reducing the variability and complacency in our current logistics systems, and we thrive on collaboration, continuous learning, and a shared vision of bringing innovation and scalability back to our automation equipment.

Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year, and the historical model let each integrator use its own equipment, controls, and methods. That variability has proven hard to support and scale. Our software organization delivers the platforms, controls architecture, and AI and computer-vision capabilities that let Amazon own its industrial automation ecosystem end to end, and this console is where a building becomes legible to the people who run it, moving operations from reacting to problems toward resolving them before they surface.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics, computer science, operations research, business analytics, information systems or equivalent
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience managing technical products or online services
Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
Experience bridging technical and business teams to collect and refine requirements, prioritize incoming work requests, and ensure all committed work is delivered on time
Experience in an operational environment developing, fast-prototyping, piloting and launching analytic products
5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
5+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred Qualifications

MBA

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

À propos du poste

Salesforce recherche un·e Directeur/Directrice de la Stratégie Produit pour rejoindre le Chief Architect Office au sein du Bureau du CEO. Rattaché·e au/à la SVP Stratégie Produit, vous serez à l'intersection de la stratégie d'entreprise et de la technologie — évaluant les technologies, modélisant la monétisation à travers différents scénarios de marché, et traduisant ces choix en recommandations d'investissement concrètes.

Ce n'est pas un rôle traditionnel de gestion de produit ou de veille concurrentielle. Nous construisons une équipe proactive et créative pour tester la robustesse des hypothèses du portefeuille et façonner les investissements technologiques les plus stratégiques de Salesforce, à travers les modèles commerciaux, l'IA agentique et les architectures logicielles.

Vous êtes aussi à l'aise pour construire un modèle de scénario autour de la monétisation de l'infrastructure IA que pour évaluer les compromis architecturaux entre différents modèles de déploiement agentique. Vous comprenez que la meilleure stratégie technologique est celle où les choix techniques et le modèle commercial sont conçus ensemble.

Vos missions

Stratégie de portefeuille et d'investissement : Diriger la planification stratégique du portefeuille IA et plateforme de Salesforce — en définissant les priorités, en séquençant les paris stratégiques, et en évaluant les options de construction, d'achat, de partenariat ou de fusion-acquisition.
Monétisation et stratégie commerciale : Concevoir et tester la robustesse des modèles de monétisation (architectures tarifaires, facturation à l'usage, API-first) pour les capacités IA émergentes, les LLM et les écosystèmes de plateforme, en partenariat avec les équipes Produit, Finance et GTM.
Planification de scénarios et thèses sectorielles : Construire des modèles multivariables et des thèses d'investissement (IA agentique, plateformes de données, infrastructures de confiance) pour tester la solidité des décisions face aux évolutions concurrentielles, réglementaires et macroéconomiques.
Solides compétences en modélisation financière et analyse quantitative : capacité à construire et à tester la robustesse de business cases, de modèles de scénarios, de cadres de dimensionnement de marché et d'analyses de retour sur investissement, ainsi qu'à utiliser des preuves quantitatives pour affiner et défendre des recommandations stratégiques.
Dynamiques des marchés régionaux : Analyser l'adoption en entreprise en France et plus largement en Europe, ainsi que les cadres réglementaires (AI Act européen, RGPD, Digital Markets Act) pour éclairer la stratégie GTM régionale et les décisions de portefeuille à l'échelle mondiale.
Livrables exécutifs : Produire des analyses stratégiques de niveau conseil d'administration et des briefings exécutifs combinant modélisation quantitative, due diligence technique et positionnement concurrentiel.

Exigences minimales

Expérience : 4 ans ou plus en stratégie d'entreprise, conseil en management, banque d'investissement/private equity, ou développement corporate dans la tech, avec un historique démontré de contribution à des décisions majeures et de direction d'équipes transverses.
Profondeur technique : Connaissance pratique des architectures IA/ML (LLM, systèmes agentiques, plateformes de données) permettant d'évaluer les compromis, de challenger les hypothèses d'ingénierie et de mener des due diligences.
Sens commercial et financier : Maîtrise approfondie des modèles de monétisation technologique (SaaS, consommation, plateforme, open source), associée à de solides compétences en modélisation financière (fusions-acquisitions, modélisation de scénarios, ROI).
Résolution de problèmes et influence : Esprit analytique capable de structurer des problématiques ambiguës selon une approche par les principes fondamentaux et de communiquer des analyses complexes auprès des dirigeants et du conseil d'administration.

Qualifications Préférées

Diplôme de premier cycle en informatique, ingénierie ou domaine technique connexe.
Expérience sectorielle dans la tech d'entreprise, l'infrastructure cloud, les bases de données vectorielles ou les frameworks d'orchestration.
Familiarité avec la chaîne d'approvisionnement, l'automatisation IA verticale et l'agentification des processus à grande échelle.
Expérience dans l'équilibre entre approches offensives (création de catégorie) et défensives (construction de barrières concurrentielles).
Connaissance approfondie de l'écosystème tech et de l'environnement réglementaire français/européen.
Diplôme avancé (MBA ou expérience équivalente).

jobs.description:
Overview

Work IQ is Microsoft 365 Copilot’s workplace intelligence layer
, enabling AI agents and experiences to securely reason over enterprise data such as emails, meetings, documents, Teams messages, and people signals. Work IQ exposes this intelligence through agent-first APIs, including the Work IQ API, CLI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, while respecting Microsoft Graph permissions, tenant policies, and compliance boundaries.

We, the M365 Core Asia Pacific Copilot extensibility engineering team, are looking for a Principal Product Manager for Work IQ whose primary product focus is evaluation
— the load-bearing quality gate of the Work IQ agent developer lifecycle. Evaluation is where an agent earns the right to ship: it spans the committed eval suite and its correspondence to the success criteria declared at scoping, measurement across quality, accuracy, latency, cost, trust, DLP behavior, and source scoping, failure triage against the response playbook, and the advisory-board sign-off that governs what customers actually receive. You will own that gate end to end — including A/B testing with BizChat, the feedback loop from production signals back into the suite, and post-release drift detection — and you will make it fast, evidence-rich, and continuous rather than a milestone event.

This role is deliberately an AI-native transformation
role, and it maps directly to the two M365 core priorities. On Changing the Way We Work
, you are expected to redesign the lifecycle itself rather than staff it: apply an agentic loop approach
to the evaluation stage so that evidence assembly, failure classification, remediation drafting, and drift detection run zero-touch, while accountable judgment — quality-gate sign-off, accepting a known failure into production, tenant admin consent, and any irreversible or externally visible action — stays with a named human by design. On Leading with New AI Products
, you will dogfood Work IQ’s own surfaces to build those loops, so the platform team experiences its activation, evaluation, and metering surfaces as a developer does, and feeds that evidence straight back into the roadmap.

We are looking for a growth mindset and thought leadership
measured in outcomes, not mechanism: human involvements per agent shipped trending toward zero for removable coordination toil, a rising acceptance rate for the loops’ recommendations, shrinking time from eval failure to resolution, a growing share of drift found by the platform before a customer reports it, and an absolute bar of no agent-caused false gate pass
. You will set the point of view, publish it, and bring partner teams along.

This is a platform PM role
at the intersection of Copilot
, agents
, Graph
, and enterprise trust
.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Make evaluation continuous rather than a milestone, keep each agent’s eval suite in correspondence with its declared success criteria, and run A/B testing with BizChat plus post-release drift detection.

Would you like to build technology products that help shape Amazon’s transition toward a more circular economy? Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

As a Principal Product Manager – Technical, you will define and lead the product strategy for some of Amazon’s most complex sustainability and regulatory challenges. You will work across engineering, science, compliance, finance, operations, and sustainability teams to automate global EPR programs, improve product and packaging data, enable compliant selling partners, and develop scalable capabilities for recycling, recovery, and circularity.

This role requires a product leader who can operate in significant ambiguity, translate evolving regulatory and business requirements into durable technical solutions, and influence across a broad set of senior stakeholders. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to build at the intersection of technology, regulation, sustainability, and Amazon-scale commerce, with the ability to influence how Amazon manages producer responsibility today and how it develops broader circularity capabilities for the future.

Key job responsibilities

Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.
Improve the Selling Partner compliance experience by building products that make requirements easier to understand and act on, reduce the effort and cost required to achieve compliance, and enable sellers to continue offering products across Amazon stores.

Own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for EPR and circular economy, leading 3-Year Vision, annual operating planning, and quarterly prioritization while aligning investments across business, technology, compliance, sustainability, and operations teams.

Drive automation and simplification across Amazon’s EPR operating model, replacing manual processes with scalable technology, improving data and classification accuracy, and strengthening controls across reporting, fees, registrations, and compliance monitoring.
Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

new_jobs.title: Director of Product Management - Adobe Builders eXperience (ABX)
new_jobs.description:
The Opportunity

In the last 6 months, agentic development has taken off – changing how software is built. We have a clear vision on how to embrace it, and an engineering org already in motion. We need a product leader to take the spark and own the connection with the builders we serve. They will turn it into strategy and keep evolving that strategy as frameworks, tools, and processes change.

Join us in the ABX org, where agentic development is the platform – a managed harness that 15,000 builders at Adobe will use to ship software with AI. Every improvement you will make compounds across engineering, product, and design, on most codebases at Adobe!

This is a build role. You'll develop the strategy, build the organizational framework from the ground up, and set the bar for what agentic development looks like at Adobe.

What You'll Own

The Builders Experience strategy.
Take an articulated-but-evolving vision and transform it into written strategy, roadmap, and objective measures of success. Expect it to change continuously as the models, harnesses, and internal processes evolve.

The platform spanning all three modes of agentic development.
ABX will serve builders wherever they are on the curve, and make each mode repeatable:

Agentic Delegation - individual acceleration; the SDLC stays the same, each function just gets faster.
Agentic Transformation - cross-functional AI pods that compress the SDLC and dissolve role boundaries.
Agentic Orchestration - ticket-to-PR factories, multi-agent loops, self-healing CI, with customer and SRE signal closing the outer loop.

The objectives and key results (OKRs).
Platform adoption → per-engineer output → per-employee productivity → business impact. We start with adoption and build up to the rest.

The relationship with the builders.
Deepen trust with the Adobe Builders community, as past decisions on models and tooling created friction. You'll build the engagement mechanisms for a real partnership, and act as chief marketer and evangelist for the platform across the org!

Build vs. buy.
Own the decision process for which external models and tools we deploy. Know the latest across the labs, hyperscalers, and open-weights - and make high-conviction calls amid an embarrassment of riches.

Execution.
Relentless focus on shipping. Remove bottlenecks, streamline how the team communicates, and automate our own SDLC intelligently - designing the moments where humans stay in the loop so judgment and taste get applied at the junctures that matter.

The operating model.
Design how this team runs, in partnership with engineering. It must be agentic itself - we build the system with our system and eat our own dog food. Expect AI pods with real ownership, some led by non-PMs and product-design-engineer (PDE) profiles, not the classic backlog-and-execute approach.

A small PM team.
Direct one PM today (who owns external-tool deployment decisions) and grow the org as the mandate expands - setting the hiring bar and the culture as you go.

What You'll Bring

Senior PM leadership with a track record of building strategy and teams from scratch
Technical credibility with builders. The best instinct here is an engineer's instinct for what engineers want - we're building tools for people who like to build their own tools. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read it and reason about it.
Deep technical fluency in agentic systems: model evaluation and selection, orchestration frameworks, evaluations, inference cost, MCP and the surrounding dev-tooling stack. Comfortable debating latency-vs-accuracy tradeoffs with principal engineers.
Strategic clarity under ambiguity. The landscape shifts weekly; you will synthesize signal from noise, make high-conviction bets on incomplete information, and adjust course as needed.
Comfort operating lean and unconventionally - small team, novel AI pods structure, strong bias to action, allergic to process theater and fluff.
A driver of reinvention - energized by collapsing role boundaries and remaking the SDLC to be AI-first.

What Sets You Apart

You've led product for a developer or AI platform inside a large engineering org (hundreds to thousands of engineers), and driven adoption of AI-augmented development tooling at scale.
You're boundary-less - you'll collaborate across Adobe and go where the outcome takes you.
You can converse across the whole agentic stack: agentic coding, CI/CD, build systems, observability, evaluations, orchestration.
A technical degree (CS, Math, Engineering, or related) or equivalent experience. We value what you've built over where you studied.

Be ready for

A vision that will change, repeatedly. We optimize for agility over certainty.
A team that's small by design, with a non-standard operating model you'll co-invent.

The person will excel at influencing stakeholders without formal authority, across a wide range of technical profiles and seniority levels. They write well, and their verbal communication is concise and perceptive. As a Product Manager-Tech, they tirelessly advocate on behalf of customers and escalate immediately when they believe course correction is needed. Design and build proof of concept experiments that best describe the quality (performance and ease of use) of the customer experiences of AWS products and services
Collaborate with engineering and science teams to build products and processes for efficient performance evaluations of AWS services
